description: Updates supplied name, contact, RSVP, communication preferences or language for a guest already recorded as 13 or older in the selected wedding. The guest identifier is required. This tool cannot change age bands, guest notes or dietary details. Requires sign-in and an Aisle membership.

broadcast_channel.description: How this guest asked to be reached by messages sent to everyone: 'email' for email only, 'sms' for text only, 'either' for no preference.

email.description: Updated email address. Empty string clears it.

guest_id.description: Identifier of a guest in the selected wedding.

language.description: Which language this guest reads. A language name ("Spanish") or a code ("es", "pt"); both store the same value. Decides the language their guest site opens in, and which version of a message they get. Empty string clears it, which is not the same as 'en': a cleared guest follows the site's own language and their browser. Records a fact; translates nothing.

phone.description: Updated phone number, including + and its country code. Empty string clears it.

preferred_transport.description: Which wire a text to this guest takes. 'sms' reaches US and Canadian numbers only; 'whatsapp' reaches any number and is the answer for a guest abroad. The guest can also choose on the wedding site.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: update_my_guest
title: Update Wedding Guest
